map.输入：上臂左 33、右 33.5；大腿左 55、右 55.5；小腿左 37、右:
Input: upper arm left 33, right 33.5; thigh left 55, right 55.5; calf left 37, right 37 (in cm).
Upper arm: mean 33.25, difference 0.5, difference % = 0.5/33.25*100 = 1.
map.康复/体态评估中，对比左右肢围度（上臂/大腿/小腿），量化不对称程度。: In rehabilitation and posture assessment, compare left-right limb circumference (upper arm / thigh / calf) to quantify the asymmetry.
map.用力训练后或伤后随访，监测两侧围度差异是否缩小。: After strength training or at injury follow-up, monitor whether the difference in girth on the two sides is shrinking.
map.差异 >10% 时提示可能存在代偿、萎缩或单侧薄弱，需重点关注。: When the difference exceeds 10% it warns of possible compensation, atrophy or unilateral weakness, which deserves close attention.
map.可复现算例：上臂 33/33.5、大腿 55/55.5、小腿 37/37 cm: Reproducible example: upper arm 33/33.5, thigh 55/55.5, calf 37/37 cm
map.综合对称分 ≥98 优秀、≥95 良好、≥90 一般、<90 需改善: Composite symmetry score >=98 excellent, >=95 good, >=90 fair, <90 needs improvement
map.常人左右差异通常在 1–3%，>10% 多提示单侧萎缩或代偿，建议结合肌力测试判: Normal left-right difference is usually 1-3%; above 10% often points to unilateral atrophy or compensation, so judge it together with strength testing

Normal left-right difference is usually 1-3%; above 10% often points to unilateral atrophy or compensation, so judge it together with strength testing.
map.测量要注意什么？: What Should I Watch Out For When Measuring?
map.同一部位取相同解剖点（如大腿取髌骨上 10cm）、同侧肢体放松站立测量；饭后/训: Use the same anatomical landmark on the same limb (for the thigh, 10cm above the kneecap) and measure relaxed, standing, on the same side; eating or training raises blood volume and temporarily enlarges girth, so measure at a fixed time (for example on waking) to keep results comparable.
